info.title: Tautulli API v2 (Varken contract)
info.description: Hand-written from the @addtoapi docstrings of plexpy/webserve.py (the source of the wiki API reference) and checked against Tautulli's source, linked from each corrected schema. Only the commands Varken calls. Every command is a fixed query string on /api/v2.

get.summary: Get the current activity on the PMS. session_key/session_id are not declared: they return a single session instead.

parameters.description: API key; the X-Api-Key header alternative only exists since v2.18.0 (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/api2.py#L106)

stream_count.description: Plex MediaContainer size attribute, a string (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L1892, https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L1924)

Activity.description: No required property: get_activity returns {} when Tautulli cannot reach Plex (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/webserve.py#L6422); counters are integers (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/webserve.py#L6396-L6415)

local.description: 0 or 1; the docstring shows "1" but plexpy emits an integer (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L1979)

secure.description: null when the player sends no secure attribute (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L1981, https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L2007-L2008)

Session.description: Required: keys get_session_each always emits and Varken reads (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L1967-L1996, https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L2074-L2075, https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L2406, https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L2475-L2479)

child_count.description: Only for show, artist and photo libraries (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L3040-L3071)

parent_count.description: Only for show, artist and photo libraries (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/pmsconnect.py#L3040-L3071)

GeoIp.description: Every field is null when plex.tv does not know it (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/plextv.py#L907-L916); on failure data becomes {error} (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/api2.py#L653-L657) with HTTP 400 (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/api2.py#L777-L783)

result.description: An error result is always sent with HTTP 400 (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/api2.py#L777-L783)

UpdateCheck.description: https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/webserve.py#L4407-L4473; api2 moves result and message to the envelope (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/api2.py#L771-L778). An unknown version answers result error, sent with HTTP 400.

result.description: An error result is always sent with HTTP 400 (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/api2.py#L777-L783)

Graph.description: Series are only listed for the library types the server has (TV, Movies, Music, Live TV) (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/graphs.py#L121-L138)

HomeStatRow.description: Union of the row dicts of every stat card; unused keys are sent as empty strings, most_concurrent rows only carry title, count, started and stopped (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/datafactory.py#L635)

HomeStat.description: stat_type is absent from popular_* and most_concurrent cards (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/datafactory.py#L635)

HistoryRow.description: Metadata columns come from a LEFT OUTER JOIN and can be null; watched_status is 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1 (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/datafactory.py#L540-L621)

LibraryTableRow.description: Columns of the last play are null for a library never played (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/libraries.py#L316-L470)

UserTableRow.description: last_seen and the columns of the last play are null for a user who never played (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/users.py#L127-L285)

MediaInfoRow.description: file_size is an empty string until known; play_count and last_played are null for an item never played (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/libraries.py#L578-L618)

MediaInfoTable.description: last_refreshed is null and data empty when the library has no item or cannot be read (https://github.com/Tautulli/Tautulli/blob/v2.19.1/plexpy/libraries.py#L483-L491)
